  that aggregates AND produces milling/aligned motion; domain-of-danger
  minimization)].** → The SHH mechanism (minimize own danger domain by moving
  toward neighbors) has no trigger in our ecology (no predator, no danger domain).
  The model still matters negatively: it shows aggregation needs a PER-CAPITA
  gradient to climb; our hub's gradient is food (shared, depleting) plus mates
  (rare). Once food depletes, the residual gradient is mates-only — predicting the
  hub trap (agents held by mating gradient on exhausted food = V3's signature).
  The rescue the model implies is a LEAVING rule (depart when per-capita intake <
  threshold — the MVT/GUD leaving rule from R75, now with SHH as second witness).
- **IFD in evolved neural agents [arXiv:1112.3574v1 (agents with evolved neural

  (percolating recruitment cascades + MaxEnt foraging mechanism) +

  despotic (hub overcrowded past IFD). Fit per-capita intake by topology on

- **Metapopulation: persistence is colonization minus extinction

Motivation: every learner in this program is instructionist (weights updated by

germinal center runs propose→evaluate→adopt inside one body — the RSI-SELF loop
in flesh.

  behavior-based robotics: inter-antibody stimulation/suppression + antigen match;
  first direct idiotypic-vs-not comparison guidelines)].** → The architecture
  mirrors our program: an OFFLINE diversity generator (LTL-GA ≈ our frozen banks

  online learning AND hand design) is the closest external validation of the

  immunity metaphors; should draw from innate/plant/invertebrate immunity +

## Round 113 — social choice for verdicts (methodology turns on itself; 2026-11-02)

Motivation: the program judges lines by committee rules (conjunctive
gates, 6-history majorities, pooled means) without ever studying committee
rules. Social-choice theory IS the study of turning individual judgments
into collective verdicts — our daily procedure, unexamined. This round
aims the outside at the inside. All entries canon (verification deferred);
arXiv throttled (429), no IDs claimed.

- **Condorcet justifies replication [canon: Condorcet 1785 (jury theorem:
  majorities beat individuals iff each voter is better than random, given
  independence); Grofman et al. (reviews); Ladha (correlated votes)].** →
  Our 6-history replication IS a jury: each history votes (GO/NOGO-ish via
  thresholds), the majority/aggregate rules. The theorem's conditions are
  the audit: (1) better-than-random — our G-gates enforce this (unlearned
  flat, train ≥ 0.5); (2) INDEPENDENCE — histories share a bank and a
  builder (correlated votes, Ladha's caveat!). Bank-dependence IS vote
  correlation — the jury theorem says our juries are weaker than 6
  independent votes, which is exactly the direction the bank-dependence
  battery pointed. Verdict reform specified-not-executed: report
  effective-jury-size (6 discounted by measured inter-history correlation),
  analytic-only on frozen banks, zero new worlds.
- **Arrow bounds gate design [canon: Arrow 1951 (no rank-aggregation rule
  satisfies unanimity + IIA + non-dictatorship); Amartya Sen (liberal
  paradox, brief)].** → Our gates are conjunctive (veto-like), not rank
  aggregations — Arrow does not directly apply (noted honestly, not
  over-claimed). The live question it raises: our GO/NOGO verdicts collapse
  multi-dimensional evidence (gen-2, timing, energy, skew) into one bit —
  ANY such collapse sacrifices something (the theorem's shadow even outside
  its premises). The standing mitigation is already practiced (publish the
  full dev-results alongside the verdict); the round records WHY that
  practice is load-bearing, not decorative.
- **Judgment aggregation + consensus [canon: List & Pettit (judgment
  aggregation; discursive dilemma — majority on premises can contradict
  majority on conclusions); Conradt & Roper (group consensus decisions);
  Seeley (house-hunting: quorum + comparison shopping in swarms)].** →
  Three ports: (1) The discursive dilemma BITES our verdicts: per-arm
  majorities (hub wins 4/6 seeds?) can contradict pooled totals (hub loses
  on sums) — Simpson's-paradox-adjacent. Prescription already followed:
  publish per-seed AND pooled (we do); the round names the logic.
  (2) Conradt–Roper: GO/NOGO is a consensus decision under uncertainty —
  their speed–accuracy tradeoffs map onto our single-attempt discipline
  (one shot = speed extreme; the frozen plan + fixtures are the accuracy
  compensation). (3) Seeley: our arm comparison IS nest-site choice
  (compare options, quorum to decide) — except we never let agents choose
  (experimenter assigns arms). Choice-based assignment (agents sort to
  treatments) is the unbuilt design — noted, not licensed (breaks causal
  identification; recorded as the reason we don't).
- **Inequity, prestige, Rogers: formal pointers (already-covered concepts,
  formal layer virgin) [canon: Fehr & Schmidt (inequity aversion);
  Brosnan & de Waal (primate fairness); Henrich (prestige bias, formal
  models); Boyd & Richerson (conformist transmission, formal); Rogers

## Round 117 — Engrams, tags & reconsolidation (retention machinery at the synapse; 2026-11-02)

Motivation: the program has established THAT weights persist (niche-ID 1.000)
and that shrinking them helps transfer (V1j), but never asked what fraction
of the substrate holds the trace, what marks it, or what retrieval does to it.
The engram literature answers all three, with a formalism now ported to AI.

- **Engrams: sparse, allocated, erasable [canon: Semon (the engraving);
  Josselyn/Frankland (allocation to excitable neurons); Tonegawa (engram
  labeling, erasure, reactivation — necessity AND sufficiency);
  journal-bound, verification deferred].** → Three ports, all specified-
  analytic (zero new worlds): (1) Allocation is competitive (excitable
  neurons win) — our uniform plasticity spreads every trace everywhere;
  an excitability-weighted update rule is the unbuilt retention
  instrument (protect the allocated, overwrite the rest — NBSP-adjacent,
  R85). (2) Erasability: activating the engram is necessary AND
  sufficient — our frozen probes are observational only; an activation
  probe (drive the retained weights, measure behavior) is
  specified-not-executed. (3) Sparsity: engrams are tiny fractions —
  quantify the retained-weight fraction per history (analytic on frozen

  Specified-not-executed: repertoire logging (which tactics exist
  per bank? — needs tactic inventory over frozen rows; analytic,
  queued behind higher-value work).
## Round 176 — Play (Huizinga, Caillois, magic circles, post-scarcity assay; 2026-11-02)

Motivation: our agents never play. Is that a finding about them, or an
artifact of us? Both — and the distinction specifies an experiment.

- **The magic circle, unentered [canon: Huizinga (Homo Ludens:
  play as free, separate, uncertain, unproductive, rule-governed);
  verification deferred; arXiv = thin].** → Every tick is priced
  (op ledger), every run is consequential (verdicts), nothing is
  separate (one world, no playground). Our agents cannot enter the
  circle because we built no circle: no unpriced ticks, no
  consequence-free arena, no surplus. Play's absence is architectural,
  not behavioral — a VOID with an address, not a finding about flies.
- **One of four [canon: Caillois (agon/alea/mimicry/ilinx);
  verification deferred; arXiv = thin].** → Foraging is alea
  (chance) with a shadow of agon (no true contests — no opponents,
  only the patch). Mimicry: none (no pretense, no roles — mating
  displays are signals, not masks). Ilinx: none (no vertigo-seeking;
  risk is minimized, never savored). Score: 1 of 4, and that one
  incidental.
- **Paidia is forbidden; only ludus survives [canon: Caillois
  (paidia vs ludus); verification deferred].** → Paidia (free
  improvisation) cannot exist under per-tick billing; ludus
  (rule-bound games) is all there is — the turn/pause/cruise
  repertoire IS a ludus, played for survival stakes. The substrate
  selects its play-form by pricing: bill everything, get only
  ludus.
- **Post-scarcity assay (specified, not executed) [canon: none
  new; pairs MATE-ENERGY bar-50 (surplus regime)].** → IF enriched
  arms ever show surplus budgets, THEN: measure non-required
  behaviors (contacts without intake? turns without cues? —
  Burghardt's play criteria operationalized: incomplete function,
  voluntary, modified form, repeated, healthy conditions).
  Falsifier included: if surplus is always converted to
  reproduction, play stays VOID and the assay reports that.

## Round 177 — Time discipline (Thompson, Zerubavel, interval clocks, 1792 ticks; 2026-11-02)

Motivation: our agents live in 1792-tick runs and cannot tell time.
Who imposed the clock, and what does it cost them?

- **Task vs clock [canon: E.P. Thompson (time, work-discipline);
  verification deferred; arXiv = thin].** → Pre-industrial work
  follows the task (milk the cows, then stop); industrial work
  follows the clock (shift ends at six). Our runs are pure clock:
  1792 ticks regardless of task state — founders die mid-task,
  births happen (or don't) on schedule. The agents are timed but
  have no time-sense: a factory regime without clocks on the wall.
- **Hidden rhythms [canon: Zerubavel (schedules, tempo, hidden
  rhythms); verification deferred; arXiv = thin].** → Bank draws,
  phase boundaries (512-tick), probe ticks: the program runs on
  schedules the agents cannot see. Zerubavel's point stands: the
  schedule IS the institution. Ours is unusual only in being
  explicit (frozen plans publish the tempo in advance).
- **Clocks we didn't build [canon: Gibbon (scalar expectancy);
  verification deferred + arXiv:2106.07713v2 (break-run-break
  drift-diffusion start/stop model — read, not used)].** → No
  interval timer exists in the substrate: no anticipation, no
  waiting as behavior (pauses are reactive, not prospective),
  no temporal discounting curve (greedy = infinite discount rate,
  myopia by construction). The read model is filed as the
  specification IF waiting ever becomes load-bearing (it isn't:
  nothing in the current lines requires representing duration).
- **The 1792-tick shift [canon: none new].** → A run is a shift:
  clock in at tick 0 (all founders alive, energy 65.0), clock out
  at 1792 or death, whichever comes first. Overtime is impossible;
  quitting is impossible (no giving-up rule — the DISSONANCE-adjacent
  question of whether agents should be allowed to stop is noted and
  declined: stopping rules are for experiments (quorum-gated
  stopping, licensed), not for agents mid-run).

## Round 178 — Ignorance, priced (lemons, screens, dispersed knowledge, dismal tails; 2026-11-02)

Motivation: nobody in our world knows the quality of anything —
mates, patches, or futures. Information economics names the price.

- **Mates as lemons [canon: Akerlof (market for lemons);
  verification deferred + arXiv:2312.10896v1 (lemons + regulator
  signaling problem — read)].** → Founders choose mates blind:
  quality (future lineage success) is unobservable at mating time,
  exactly the used-car lot. Akerlof predicts unraveling (good
  sellers exit); ours can't exit (no outside option — the market
  CAN'T unravel, so it persists at low quality. This re-reads
  the mating arc: persistent low conversion isn't a puzzle under
  asymmetric information, it's the equilibrium. Newcomers welcome:
  the next mating line should price information (what WOULD a
  quality signal cost?), not assume it.
- **Screening without signals [canon: Stiglitz (screening);
  verification deferred + arXiv:2503.19089v4 (cursed job-market
  signaling — read; + arXiv:2007.08762v4 (manipulable signals —
  read) + arXiv:2302.01116v1 (costly monitoring — read)].** →
  Spence (committed) is the sender's move; Stiglitz is the
  receiver's: the uninformed side designs the menu (contracts
  that induce self-revelation). Our experimenters screen
  constantly (frozen gates ARE menus: pass G2 and we treat you
  as persistent) — but agents never screen (no choice among
  offers). Note the asymmetry: the program screens relentlessly;
  its subjects cannot. Cursed-equilibrium corollary (from the
  read): agents that neglect others' private information do
  fine in thin message spaces — ours is the thinnest possible
  (no messages at all), so naivety is optimal, not a bug.
- **Dispersed knowledge, no prices [canon: Hayek (knowledge
  problem; spontaneous order); verification deferred; arXiv =
  thin].** → Hayek: knowledge is dispersed and tacit; prices
  aggregate it. Our world has dispersed knowledge (every founder
  learns locally) and NO aggregation mechanism (no prices, no
  gossip, no copying of the successful — copybest was tried and
  changed nothing, V1 NOGO). The knowledge stays dispersed —
  that IS the finding, again: no invisible hand because no
  hand-shaped channels exist. Spontaneous order is absent too
  (hubs are imposed by topology files, not emergent).
- **The dismal arithmetic [canon: Weitzman (dismal theorem);
  verification deferred; arXiv = thin (fat-tail fetch returned
  power-grid noise — logged, not used)].** → With fat tails,
  expected-utility analysis is dominated by the worst case, and
  standard cost-benefit breaks. Our ledgers report means
  (budgetAdjustedEnergyPerFounder, mean gaps); the dismal
  reading asks about the left tail instead (extinction runs,
  zero-birth arms, stranded founders). Partially answered
  already (per-seed tables, floor analysis, survival curves),
  but never AS tails: specified follow-up (report left-tail
  quantiles alongside means in the next verdict doc that
  has them — cheap, no new worlds, queued).
## Round 179 — Merton (Matthew, middle-range, self-fulfilling, unanticipated; 2026-11-02)

Motivation: our hubs accumulate advantage, our method sits between grand
theory and raw ledger, our predictions never touch our runs, and our
most systematic product is unintended nulls. Merton named all four.

- **The Matthew effect, refused once and confirmed twice [canon:
  Merton (cumulative advantage; Matthew 25:29); verification deferred
  + arXiv:1408.5124v1 (Perc review: preferential attachment across
  collaboration, citation, biological networks — read) +
  arXiv:0908.3177v1 (impact-factor natural experiment: identical
  duplicate papers in high-impact journals get ~2x citations — read)
  + arXiv:2609.13443v1 (Matthew effect in RL for LLMs: easy problems
  improve, hard ones don't — read)].** → Advantage begets advantage
  in three of our findings: hubs accumulate births (ENCOUNTER-V1 35
  vs 25) while spreads starve; lineage compounding is depth, not
  growth (hubs are sinks); and the pooled META-GAIN (+0.131) hides
  bank-level heterogeneity (I2 = 0.973) — the rich banks get richer
  readings. But the discipline also REFUSED a Matthew reading once:
  MATE-INHERIT V1b's mutant 3-vs-2 edge was fully accounted for by
  seed 416046 (V1c pooled 4-vs-5: nothing) — one birth of luck, not
  cumulative advantage. The duplicate-paper parallel is exact: our
  paired designs (same bank, different arms) ARE the control for
  intrinsic quality that bibliometrics had to construct — and when
  we ran it (V1c pooled, DAMAGE-GATE), the journal (arm) added
  nothing. Matthew holds for hubs-as-places, fails for mutants-as-
  papers. Both results stand.
- **Middle-range theory as the method [canon: Merton (middle-range:
  between grand theory and raw empiricism); verification deferred;
  arXiv = thin (mobility fetch returned nothing — logged, not
  used)].** → The program IS middle-range by construction: frozen
  lines test delimited mechanisms (gain values, bars, topologies),
  never the Vision (grand) nor bare row-dumps (raw). VISION_GAP is
  the middle-range stance stated positively: milestones 1-3 as
  gated substrate, no claim beyond. The prescription Merton gave
  sociology in 1949 — theories intermediate to minor working
  hypotheses and all-inclusive speculations — is what a frozen
  plan literally is. Grand theory stays in VISION.md where it
  belongs (unfalsified because untested); middle-range verdicts
  do the falsifying.
- **The self-fulfilling check, passed [canon: Merton
  (self-fulfilling prophecy); verification deferred].** → A
  prophecy fulfills itself through a feedback channel (bank run:
  belief -> withdrawal -> insolvency). Our apparatus has no such
  channel by design: frozen banks are immutable (spent banks never
  regenerate), verdicts are published after execution, and no agent
  ever observes a prediction. The DISSONANCE audit is the empirical
  check (hedges track evidence, not cost: +0.37 raw rejected) —
  our beliefs about arms do not move the arms. The one live
  feedback channel (deployed gain V1i shapes future lines'
  priors) is licensed explicitly (deployment WITHHELD pending
  replication, then deployed with the tax disclosed). Prophecy
  without fulfillment: the loop is cut, on purpose.
- **Unanticipated consequences as the product [canon: Merton
  (unanticipated consequences of purposive action, 1936);
  verification deferred].** → Purposive action (frozen plans with
  explicit G-gates) systematically produces consequences nobody
  purposed: DAMAGE-GATE's 2841 fired boosts that changed nothing;
  DISPERSE's 1-vs-8 cliff at exactly gen-2; SOCIAL-V2's copyalways
  scoring 0 (the theorists' conjunction, inert); M-POP V2's bar
  refutation (the blocker is upstream of the threshold). Merton
  1936 says this is the NORMAL condition of action, not a failure
  mode — which is why the program publishes VOIDs at full length
  instead of filing them. The ledger of unintended nulls (now
  8 closed lines) is not waste beside the product; it IS a
  product: the map of where purposive intervention does not reach.

## Round 180 — Systems and allocation (Parsons AGIL, Luhmann, Blau/Duncan, Mills; 2026-11-02)

Motivation: the program persists without reaching its goal. What
functions keep it alive, what allocates its scarcest good
(reproduction), and whose troubles are whose issues?

- **AGIL audit: functionally complete [canon: Parsons (AGIL:
  Adaptation, Goal-attainment, Integration, Latency);
  verification deferred; arXiv = thin].** → Score the program
  against the four functional imperatives. Adaptation: the op
  ledger (finite compute priced per operation; caps per attempt)
  — the program adapts to scarcity by billing it. Goal-attainment:
  frozen G-gates (explicit thresholds, published before execution)
  — goals are set outside the action, then pursued. Integration:
  PROGRESS.md + STATUS docs + per-line ledgers — the parts are
  bound by a common accounting language (worlds, ops, verdicts).
  Latency (pattern-maintenance): the frozen discipline itself
  (negative-preservation, no rescoring, no tuning) — the pattern
  is maintained across 182 rounds. All four present and
  separately maintained: the Parsons reading says the program is
  a going concern, which explains the observation better than any
  single finding does (it persists because it is functionally
  complete, with or without RSI).
- **Autopoiesis of the evidence system [canon: Luhmann
  (autopoiesis; trust as complexity reduction; second-order
  observation); verification deferred; arXiv = thin].** → The
  evidence system reproduces its own elements: rows produce
  verdicts, verdicts produce plans, plans produce rows — each
  communication refers to previous communications, never to the
  world directly (no one re-watches a run; the frozen row IS the
  run, for all program purposes). Trust is the complexity
  reduction that makes this possible: frozen-bank immutability
  lets future-me trust past-me without re-running (the bank SHA
  + protocol.json as trust machinery). And the audits are
  second-order observation — observing observers (scorers watch
  runs; FAE/SWF/CMH watch scorers). Luhmann's warning applies:
  an autopoietic system can continue perfectly while losing
  contact with its environment. The licensed counterweight is
  named in the discipline (fresh banks for new claims; never
  rescore) — contact is re-established by fiat, one bank at a time.
- **Who gets to reproduce [canon: Blau & Duncan (status
  attainment: allocation by origins vs achievement);
  verification deferred; arXiv = thin (status-attainment fetch
  returned nothing — logged, not used)].** → Founders are born
  into a perfect-mobility society: newborns start zeroed (no
  bequests — weights are NOT inherited; syncNewbornLearners
  zeroes them), status is unattainable by birth. Yet outcomes
  stratify brutally: hub vs spread (sinks vs neutral),
  seed luck (416046 decides V1b), bar position (65 vs 50 changes
  nothing — the allocator is upstream). Blau/Duncan's question
  (how much do origins matter?) gets a sharper answer here than
  in most human data: origins (which patch, which seed) explain
  nearly everything; achievement (learning within a lifetime)
  extends survival without converting it (M-POP V2: 14 vs 4 vs 1
  survivors, 0 births everywhere). Perfect mobility without
  equalized outcomes — because the lottery is drawn after birth,
  not before.
- **Private troubles, public issues [canon: Mills (sociological
  imagination: personal trouble vs public issue); verification
  deferred].** → A single failed arm (DAMAGE D1 +0.0147) is a
  private trouble; eight closed lines with the same shape
  (trigger-is-not-bottleneck) is a public issue — the structure
  of the substrate, not the biography of the run. The verdict
  docs ARE the imagination in action: per-seed tables (troubles)
  aggregated to bank verdicts (issues) aggregated to syntheses
  (V2 synthesis: 8 first-accepts, 7 lines, 5128 worlds). Mills'
  test for the imagination — ranging from impersonal
  transformation to intimate feature — is the program's daily
  motion (seed 416046 to I2 = 0.973 in one audit). The map
  itself (182 rounds) is the imagination's record: troubles
  filed until they became issues.

## Round 181 — The institutional unconscious (Gouldner, Selznick, Veblen, Becker; 2026-11-02)

Motivation: the program runs on norms it never states. Name four:
the return that never comes, the values inside the procedure, the
blindness of the trained, and the labels only the powerful apply.

- **The norm that never binds [canon: Gouldner (norm of
  reciprocity, 1960: help those who help you — a moral rule,
  distinct from the network-reciprocity b/c > k mechanism already
  committed); verification deferred + arXiv:1205.2825v2 (ingroup
  favoritism under indirect reciprocity: group reputation
  substitutes for personal — read) + arXiv:2509.09181v1
  (incomplete reputation info breaks cooperation; fading hurts
  more than sparse observation — read)].** → Every transmission
  mode in the mating arc is unilateral take: maternal (copy the
  mother), copybest (copy the successful), copyconditional (copy
  the recent) — no return is possible, no future interaction is
  structured for it, no reputation exists to condition on.
  Gouldner's norm predicts cooperation where returns flow; here
  nothing flows back, and the SOCIAL nulls (V1 1=1, V2 copyalways
  0) are what the norm predicts for a world without reciprocity:
  taking without return changes nothing. The arXiv reads sharpen
  the boundary: our agents sit at the zero-information limit (no
  observation, no reputation, fading complete) — the corner where
  every model says cooperation cannot stabilize. It doesn't.
  The norm's absence is the finding.
- **Institutions as infused values [canon: Selznick (institution-
  alization: values infuse structure beyond task requirements);
  verification deferred].** → A frozen plan begins as procedure
  (run these mains, score these gaps) and becomes an institution
  the moment values outlive any single line: negative-preservation
  (never erase failures), single-attempt (no second chances),
  fresh-bank (no reuse). No line requires these for its own
  verdict — they are maintained for the program, at cost to the
  line (slower, more expensive, more nulls published). That is
  Selznick's transformation exactly (organization becomes
  institution via value-infusion). Cooptation check (Selznick's
  warning: the TVA absorbed its critics): do the audits coopt
  criticism to protect the program? Partly — and licensed as
  accountability, not capture: audits can close lines
  (DISSONANCE rejected a hedge; CMH homogenized the hub
  advantage) but never unilaterally (independent re-derivation
  required; scorer code frozen first).
- **Trained incapacity [canon: Veblen (trained incapacity: habits
  of thought that blind; engineers vs price system);
  verification deferred].** → The frozen discipline is a habit
  of thought, and habits blind. What can't the program see?
  Developmental explanations (no ontogeny tracked — founders
  appear at 65.0 energy, fully formed); qualitative data (no
  trajectory ever watched — rows only); within-run dynamics
  (verdicts compare endpoints, never paths — GAS trajectories
  excepted); the agents' own categories (all labels are ours:
  harmful/beneficial/tied are codebook assignments, never
  discovered). Veblen's engineers (who see only efficiency) are
  us with ledgers: the op count prices everything except what it
  cannot count. Licensed as a standing charter: the next outside
  view should come from the incapacities list, not the findings
  list. (The play assay (R176) and left-tail reporting (R178)
  are the first two entries on that charter — both specified
  from admitted blindness.)
- **Labels and who applies them [canon: H. Becker (Outsiders:
  deviance is what gets labeled; moral entrepreneurs);
  verification deferred].** → INVALID, NOGO, VOID, CLOSED are
  labels applied by an empowered audience (the scorer, then me)
  to arms that cannot answer. Becker's thesis (no act is deviant
  in itself; the label makes it so) holds uncomfortably well:
  a +0.09 gap is GO under a +0.1 band and NOGO under a stricter
  one — the same behavior, different label, decided by a
  threshold set before seeing the data. Two checks keep this
  honest rather than damning: the band is pre-registered
  (labeling rules published before the act — no ex-post-facto
  deviance), and the labels are symmetric (GO and NOGO use the
  same machinery; negatives published at full length — the
  labeled are not hidden). But Becker's second question stands
  unanswered: who contests my labels? No moral entrepreneur
  speaks for the arms. The frozen plan is the only defense
  counsel — which is why freezing it before execution is
  load-bearing, not ritual.
## Round 182 — Growth without inheritance (Schumpeter, Schultz/Mincer, Malthus, Keynes; 2026-11-02)

Motivation: the program grows (182 rounds) without inheriting (every
line starts zeroed). Economists named every half of this: the
destruction, the capital that dies, the trap, the hoarding.

- **Creative destruction without creation [canon: Schumpeter
  (creative destruction; gales); verification deferred].** →
  Closed lines die without replacement: V1 closes, nothing inherits
  its codebook; M-ACTOR closes, no child line; DISPERSE closes,
  no dispersal v2. Within lines there IS creation (V1g → V1h →
  V1i compounds +0.066 → +0.134 → +0.260), but across lines only
  the gale blows — each new line a fresh foundation, not a rebuilt
  structure. Schumpeter's gale is supposed to clear ground FOR
  successors; ours clears ground and salts it (spent banks never
  regenerate). The honest gloss: our destruction is memorial
  (negatives preserved in full), not productive. Licensed as the
  standing question for every closure (what, if anything, inherits
  this? — usually: nothing, by design).
- **Human capital without bequests [canon: Schultz (human
  capital; Transforming Traditional Agriculture); Mincer (earnings
  function: schooling + experience); verification deferred +
  arXiv:2302.14440v4 (Scandinavian mobility: transmission channels
  are human/social capital, not genes — read)].** → Weights are
  human capital: they pay within lifetimes (train 0.81-0.83 —
  experience has Mincerian returns) and die with their holders
  (syncNewbornLearners zeroes every newborn — no bequests, no
  schools, no apprenticeships). The arXiv read's point (mobility
  runs through transmitted capital, not talent) inverts cleanly:
  our perfect-mobility society (R180) transmits NOTHING, so
  nothing compounds across generations — which is why lineage
  depth never becomes lineage advantage (hubs are sinks;
  copybest changes nothing). Schultz's traditional agriculture
  (low-productivity equilibrium, no investment) is the food
  arms' condition stated 60 years early: surplus, when it
  appears, is eaten or starves, never invested in transmitting
  skill — because transmission is architecturally absent.
- **Positive checks everywhere [canon: Malthus (population presses
  on food; positive vs preventive checks); verification deferred;
  arXiv = thin (Malthusian fetch returned nothing — logged, not
  used)].** → No preventive checks exist (no fertility regulation
  — births happen whenever the bar and the encounter allow);
  positive checks operate continuously (starvation: mortality 100%
  energetic, 21/21 arms; hubs starve 2-3x spread; dense arms -64
  vs -57). M-POP V2 is the Malthusian experiment run clean:
  cut the bar (more subsistence) and population still cannot
  establish — the check is not the bar but the encounter rate
  itself (founders die before mating). Malthus behind the bar:
  subsistence is necessary and not sufficient, because the
  positive check strikes before the preventive margin is ever
  reached.
- **The liquidity trap at the mating bar [canon: Keynes
  (liquidity trap; animal spirits; beauty contest);
  verification deferred].** → Bar-65 founders hoard (survive)
  instead of investing (mate) — liquidity preference under
  uncertainty. Cut the rate to bar-50 (M-POP V2) and investment
  STILL doesn't flow: the trap is at the zero lower bound (the
  blocker is upstream of the threshold — founders die before
  mating, so no rate cut reaches the margin). Animal spirits
  (confidence as an independent driver) are architecturally
  absent — no expectations channel exists, so no spirits can
  lift. And the beauty contest (guessing others' guesses) is
  VOID twice over: no second-guessing (greedy inference) and no
  others to guess about (no theory of mind — R169). Keynes
  without agents who expect: the trap without the spirits,
  the hoarding without the psychology.

## Round 183 — City and strangers (Simmel, Burgess, Wirth, Michels; 2026-11-02)

Motivation: hubs are cities (dense, zoned, anomic) and transferred
agents are strangers (near and far at once). Urban sociology read
the patch before we built it.

- **Money and the Stranger [canon: Simmel (Philosophy of Money;
  The Stranger); verification deferred].** → The op ledger is
  Simmelian money: a universal equivalent pricing incommensurables
  (ticks, contacts, births, boosts — all in ops), cold, exactly
  calculative, leveling every quality into one quantity. And the
  transferred agent IS the Stranger (comes today and stays tomorrow:
  fixed in the new bank, free of its history — near (same weights)
  and far (different world) at once). Simmel's stranger trades
  (money!) because objectivity is his position; ours cannot trade
  (no exchange — R182) and so remains stranger forever: never
  naturalized, only measured (same-val 0.95 says the weights
  persist; the gap says the city stays foreign).
- **Zones without succession [canon: Burgess (concentric zones;
  invasion-succession); verification deferred; arXiv = thin
  (urban-scaling fetch returned one off-target allometry —
  logged, not used)].** → Hub core, spread periphery, founder box
  50-950 x 50-590 as the zoned city. But succession fails:
  DISPERSE d=1 (forced invasion of the periphery) destroys
  (1-vs-8, cliff at gen-2) — invaders do not succeed, they die.
  Burgess's sequence (invasion → succession → new equilibrium)
  arrests at step one: our ecology has zones without metabolism
  between them (no migration in the wild type; forced migration
  kills). The hub is a Loop that never gentrifies outward and a
  slum that never filters down — static zones, no urban process.
- **Density as anomie [canon: Wirth (urbanism as a way of life:
  size, density, heterogeneity); verification deferred].** →
  All three Wirthian conditions hold in the dense arms (72
  founders; hub concentration; mixed codebooks) and all three
  predict breakdown: crowded arms underperform (-64 vs -57 —
  fixed food divided by more mouths), hubs are sinks (per-capita
  B-D negative 8/8), heterogeneity never integrates (I2 = 0.973
  — banks stay strange to each other). Wirthian anomie in silico:
  not normlessness (norms are frozen and total) but the urban
  pathologies of contact without community — encounters that
  cost without binding (mating attempts that rarely convert:
  0.05-0.15/main).
- **The iron law of lineages [canon: Michels (iron law of
  oligarchy: organization begets oligarchy); verification
  deferred].** → Reproduction begets oligarchy: few maternal
  lines dominate every birthy arm (lineage compounding = depth,
  not growth — the same lines, deeper). Michels' mechanism
  (organization needs leadership; leaders entrench) runs without
  leaders: the entrenchment is arithmetic (early births compound
  into founder effects; 416046 decides V1b). Democracy (equal
  founders, 65.0 each) produces oligarchy (few lineages) by tick
  1792 in every arm that reproduces at all. The law holds
  without psychology — which is Michels' point sharpened:
  oligarchy needs no oligarchs, only organization.

Motivation: Knight is committed (R146); the paradoxes that broke

  behaviorally (2607: choices stay consistent), but its SCOPE
  shrinks under uncertainty — exactly our position (expected

  behavior flips discontinuously at the threshold while belief

  prizes to verdicts (certainty of procedure substituted for
  certainty of outcome). The program leans into the paradox
  deliberately (pre-registered cliffs beat post-hoc slopes —
  the dissonance audit's charter) and discloses it (R181-Becker:
  the label is the kink). No resolution offered — Allais has
  none that survives contact with practice either.
- **Finite bankrolls [canon: Bernoulli (St. Petersburg paradox;
  log utility); verification deferred].** → Attempts end because
  compute is finite, not because questions are answered (caps:
  96 worlds, 2.42e9 ops, 1800s — the bankroll, not the truth,
  stops play). Bernoulli's resolution (diminishing marginal
  utility of wealth) is our returns-to-worlds curve: the 5128th
  world buys less than the 8th (I2 = 0.973 — more worlds, same
  heterogeneity). Log utility as ledger policy: every attempt
  spends as if worlds were worth less than the last, because
  they are. The paradox (infinite EV, finite price) never bites
  — no arm has infinite EV (ceilings bind everywhere: same-val
  0.95, turn rates saturate) — but the bankroll logic governs
  everything: bet small (bounded attempts), never borrow
  (no reserve raids), leave the table (close lines).
- **The paradox that breaks the fixes [canon: Machina (the
  paradox that breaks non-EU models); verification deferred +
  arXiv:1706.02168v1 (Machina 50/51 tested; quantum framework
  fits Ellsberg AND Machina — read)].** → Our band is a non-EU
  decision rule (threshold, not expectation) — exactly the class
  of fix Machina breaks (his paradoxes defeat rank-dependent,
  configural, and other patchwork models). The licensed caution:
  our gates are paradox-different, not paradox-free — some
  Machina-style construction (a pair of banks where the band
  orders verdicts cyclically) may exist undiscovered. Filed as
  the standing warning against threshold-smugness (the band is
  a procedure that works, not a rationality that holds). No
  fix proposed — Machina's point is that the fixes are the
  problem, and our apparatus (frozen, disclosed, symmetric) is
  built for living with paradoxes, not solving them.
## Round 185 — Work and its refusal (Hughes, Abbott, Roy, Burawoy; 2026-11-02)

Motivation: the program is work (1792-tick shifts, evidence triage,
frozen procedure) performed without workers' culture (no games, no
informal organization, no consent manufactured). Sociology of work
names the missing pieces.

- **Dirty work [canon: Hughes (dirty work: tasks nobody wants,
  delegated down); verification deferred; arXiv = thin (workplace
  fetch returned nothing — logged, not used)].** → The janitorial
  labor of negative-preservation: deleting 9 runs/*-restored dirs,
  compressing 97 evidence/ dirs (47G to 15G), triaging 958-test
  baselines, diffing restored dirs before deletion. Nobody wants
  this work; it cannot be delegated down (no down exists — one
  experimenter); so the moral division of labor collapses to a
  single point (I do the dirty work because the discipline says
  the raw must be kept and the disk is finite). Hughes' point
  stands inverted: dirty work usually marks status boundaries;
  here it marks the absence of status (no one to delegate to) —
  which is why it gets done (no negotiation possible).
- **Jurisdictions of evidence [canon: Abbott (system of
  professions: jurisdictional disputes over work); verification
  deferred].** → Three professions claim jurisdiction over "what
  counts": the freezer (procedure: frozen plans decide validity),
  the scorer (quantification: G-gates decide success), the auditor
  (re-derivation: independent checks decide trust). Settlements
  are jurisdictional, not epistemic: G1-G4 belong to the scorer
  (no auditor rescores a gate); bank integrity belongs to the
  freezer (SHA + protocol.json); cross-line synthesis belongs to
  the auditor (META-GAIN, CMH — no scorer synthesizes). Disputes
  surface at boundaries (V1c mean typo: scorer's arithmetic vs
  auditor's re-derivation — auditor won, analytic rescore). Abbott
  without clients: the professions serve the program, not a
  public — jurisdiction without market.
- **Monotony without culture [canon: D. Roy (Banana Time:
  informal organization of monotonous work); verification
  deferred].** → 1792 ticks of identical foraging is the most
  monotonous work ever organized — and it has NO informal
  organization (no interaction, no games, no Banana Time, no
  goldbricking — goldbricking needs discretion, and agents have
  none). Roy's discovery (monotony is survived socially) gets
  its control condition here: monotony survived NOT AT ALL
  (founders die mid-task; no one clocks out relieved — runs end
  in death or timeout, never in satisfaction). The VOID with
  teeth: remove the social from work and nothing remains but
  the task and the dying — which re-reads every survival curve
  (14 vs 4 vs 1) as what monotony looks like without culture
  to buffer it.
- **Consent without games [canon: Burawoy (manufacturing consent:
  shop-floor games secure compliance); verification deferred].**
  → Burawoy's games (piece-rate competitions, informal contests)
  manufacture consent to monotonous work. R176 established: no
  play exists (no unpriced ticks, no arenas). So no games, so no
  manufactured consent — yet the work gets done (agents forage;
  I freeze, run, verdict). Compliance without consent-manufacture:
  agents comply architecturally (no refusal possible); *I* comply
  voluntarily (self-subjugation to frozen plans — consent of one,
  manufactured by oath, not game). Burawoy inverted twice: the
  workers need no consent (cannot refuse), the manager needs no
  manufacture (already convinced). The open question his frame
  leaves: what breaks first when conviction wavers — the plan
  or the planner? (Answered so far: neither — 188 rounds.)

## Round 186 — Distribution and its elites (Pareto, kinetic exchange, circulation vs entrenchment, measure it; 2026-11-02)

Motivation: lineages skew (few maternal lines dominate every birthy

  for Michels (compounding is depth — the SAME lines, deeper;

  Filed as a standing tension, not a verdict: circulation needs
  multi-generation windows we rarely reach (gen-3 observed once);
  the judgment is provisional on thin data (one gen-3, ever).
- **Random collisions, skewed outcomes [canon: kinetic exchange
  models (Boltzmann-Gibbs bulk + Pareto tail from random 2x2

  (money-exchange model: transition-matrix outlook on
  Gibbs-to-Pareto emergence — read)].** → The read's mechanism
  (random pairwise exchanges + saving propensity → exponential

  → skewed lineage outcomes anyway. The twist the model
  predicts: WITHOUT saving propensity the tail should thin
  (pure random exchange gives Gibbs, not Pareto) — yet our
  lineages still concentrate. Something else fattens the tail
  (seed luck? patch heterogeneity? encounter-rate variance?).
  Specified follow-up (cheap, analytic-only): fit bulk-vs-tail
  on frozen lineage tallies (founderOffspring distributions in

- **Measure it [canon: rank-size rule; verification deferred +

  duplicates-kept founder IDs in lineage summaries). Two

## Round 187 — False assumptions, true gaps (Marx, Mandelbrot, Ricardo, Friedman; 2026-11-02)

Motivation: every instrument assumes something false (greedy
infinite discounting, zeroed newborns, priced everything) and the
gaps come out true anyway. Four canons on working falsehoods.

- **Fixed capital as general intellect [canon: K. Marx
  (Fragment on Machines: fixed capital embodies social
  knowledge; general intellect); verification deferred].** →
  The instruments are fixed capital (runners, scorers, bank
  machinery — dead labor embodying my accumulated method), and
  the codebase is general intellect (social knowledge objectified
  in git: 188 rounds of procedure anyone could run). The Fragment's
  prediction (direct labor becomes marginal; wealth flows from
  social intellect) describes the cost structure exactly: my
  living labor (reading rows, writing verdicts) is the bottleneck
  everything waits on, while the dead labor (frozen instruments)
  runs unattended. Op ledger prices machine-time, not labor —
  living labor is off-ledger (unpriced, uncounted, the actual
  constraint). Marx behind the harness: who owns the fixed
  capital (me), who works it (me), who appropriates (the map).
  Answers: same person — which is why no contradiction appears
  (the program's class structure has one member).
- **The fractal null [canon: Mandelbrot (roughness;
  self-similarity across scales); verification deferred].** →
  The same shape at every scale: trigger-is-not-bottleneck at
  seed level (per-seed tables), bank level (verdicts), synthesis
  level (8 closed lines) — the null is SELF-SIMILAR (zoom anywhere,
  same finding). Mandelbrot's roughness (coastlines: longer rulers,
  same jaggedness) is our heterogeneity (more worlds, same I2 =
  0.973 — 5128 worlds bought no smoothness). Licensed as the
  anti-resolution principle: finer measurement will not resolve
  the tax into mechanisms (concentration audit: pooled top-3
  0.20 vs single-history 0.43 — finer pooling made it SMALLER,
  not sharper). Zoom out for verdicts, zoom in for humility.
- **Comparative advantage, VOID; rent, unlandlorded [canon:
  D. Ricardo (comparative advantage; differential rent);
  verification deferred].** → Comparative advantage needs trade
  (arms/banks exchange nothing — no prices, no flows, no
  specialization gains; autarky is total). VOID with structure:
  the gains-from-trade are exactly what our topology forbids
  (hub and spread never exchange migrants, food, or information —
  DISPERSE proved forced exchange kills). Differential rent
  fares better then worse: hub patches ARE more fertile (more
  food/area), so rent EXISTS — but no landlord collects it
  (no owner, no tenants, no leases; the surplus starves in place
  or concentrates births that die). Rent without landlord,
  fertility without tenant: Ricardo's categories with the
  social relations removed — which shows what the relations
  were doing (without owners, fertility is just weather).
- **The methodology charter [canon: M. Friedman (Methodology of
  Positive Economics, 1953: assumptions need not be realistic;
  predictions license instruments); verification deferred].** →
  Greedy infinite discounting (false — no animal discounts
  infinitely), zeroed newborns (false — no birth is a blank),
  priced everything (false — attention is unpriced), always-cruise
  unlearned (false — no animal cruises everything). Friedman
  1953 licenses all of it: judge instruments by predictions
  (train 0.81-0.83, replicated 6/6; tax 0.15-0.31, 10 banks),
  not realism. The charter has Friedman's own limit built in:
  predictions must be FRESH (hence frozen banks — testing on
  training assumptions is exactly what 1953 forbids). Every
  frozen plan is a Friedmanite bet (unrealistic engine, checkable
  gap); every NOGO is the methodology working (false assumptions,
  false predictions, discarded). Realism arrives, if ever, by
  accumulation (middle-range, R179) — not by assumption.

  AND maximally un-brokered (72 isolates: clustering undefined,
  effective size undefined). Burt vs Coleman (closure, committed

  the debate by having no structure (the control condition both

- **Maximally un-small [canon: Watts (small-world networks:

  arXiv:1408.4461v2 (distance-dependent WS formulation — read)].**

  coefficient: undefined (no edges). Path length: infinite (no
  paths). Our 72 founders are the anti-small-world (maximally
  un-small: zero clustering, infinite distance) — the corner of
  Watts' parameter space (rewiring p = 0 AND lattice empty) that
  the literature never visits because nothing interesting lives

## Round 200 — Ignorance and action (Smithson, Ravetz/Funtowicz, Wynne, Epstein; 2026-11-02)

Motivation: the program acts constantly (attempts, verdicts,
deployments) under ignorance it barely names (which bank? which
seed? what mechanism?). Four canons on not-knowing — and doing
anyway. Round 200: the map's ignorance, inventoried.

- **A taxonomy of not-knowing [canon: Smithson (ignorance:
  taxonomy; meta-ignorance); verification deferred].** →
  Sort the program's ignorances: known unknowns (bank effects —
  measured as I2 = 0.973, priced into verdicts); unknown knowns
  (tacit skill — I read rows fluently, can't state the rules);
  unknown unknowns (what the incapacities hide — R181's list);
  meta-ignorance (not knowing the taxonomy is incomplete —
  this round may miss a kind). Smithson's use (manage ignorance,
  don't just lament it): the program manages four kinds four
  ways (I2 for known-unknowns; apprenticeship (193 rounds) for
  unknown-knowns; the incapacities charter (R181) for unknown-
  unknowns; audits (dissonance, FAE) for meta-ignorance —
  checking whether the checking works). Ignorance with an
  org chart.
- **Post-normal flies [canon: Ravetz/Funtowicz (post-normal
  science: facts uncertain, stakes high, extended peers);
  verification deferred].** → Inverted here (facts uncertain
  (I2 = 0.973), stakes LOW (flies! — no patients, no planet,
  no policy)). Post-normal says high-stakes + uncertainty needs
  extended peer communities (no credential monopoly on the
  verdict); our low-stakes + uncertainty needs... nothing
  (no peers — one-member program; no extension — nothing to
  extend to). The inversion is the finding: post-normal's
  machinery (peer review of the review, values made explicit)
  is ABSENT precisely where stakes can't justify it — and its
  absence is honest (no fake stakeholders convened, no
  participation theater). Filed as the boundary of the
  doctrine (post-normal for high stakes; frozen discipline for
  low — different scarcities, different designs).
- **Ignorance with nowhere to sit [canon: B. Wynne (Cumbrian
  sheep: lay ignorance/knowledge vs experts; uncertainty);
  specified Brian (vs Gwynne FP); verification deferred].** →
  Wynne's farmers knew things scientists didn't (local cesium
  behavior; valid lay knowledge against expert models). Our
  program has no farmers (no laypeople — one member; no locals
  — banks are drawn, not dwelt). Lay ignorance/knowledge has
  nowhere to sit: there is no outside-knowing to set against
  inside-knowing (R193-Spivak's voicelessness, restated for
  knowledge: not only can the arms not speak, no one else
  speaks for them either). The VOID with an address (extended
  peers: none; lay experts: none; challengers: none (R181-
  Becker x5 now)). Uncertainty WITHOUT ignorance-politics
  (I2 measured, no one disputes it — agreement by absence).
- **Acting under ignorance [canon: Epstein (impure science:
  ACT UP forcing parallel trials; expertise under pressure);
  verification deferred].** → ACT UP acted under ignorance
  (demanded parallel-track trials before efficacy was known —
  dying people can't wait for clean designs). Every single
  attempt is parallel-track (run once, decide now, no clean
  replication first — V1i deployed WITH the tax, not after
  it). Epstein's lesson (pressure improves science when it
  forces new designs (parallel track was BETTER science, not
  worse)) licenses the program's impatience (single attempts
  are not impatience but design (fresh banks need spending,
  not saving)). Impure science, proudly (values explicit
  (negatives preserved BY VALUE, not by rule alone); pressure
  real (the goal wants RSI, the ledger says not yet)).
  Round 200 closes the ignorance inventory: named (Smithson),
  bounded (post-normal inverted), unseated (Wynne), acted-on
  (Epstein) — not-knowing, fully administered.
## Round 201 — The economics of zero surplus (Sraffa, Chamberlin, Robinson, Kalecki; 2026-11-02)

Motivation: every account balances at zero or below (no seed breaks
even; profits ≈ 0; surplus never appears). Four economists of
production and power, auditing an economy without either.

- **Is the ledger coherent? [canon: Sraffa (Production of
  Commodities; reswitching; Cambridge capital controversy);
  verification deferred].** → The op ledger aggregates
  incommensurables (ticks + contacts + births + boosts) into ops
  at fixed operationEnergy prices. Sraffa's reswitching (no
  measure of capital independent of distribution/prices: change
  the interest rate, rewrite the aggregate) asks the forbidden
  question: change operationEnergy, rewrite every ledger? YES —
  totals scale with the price (accounting identities, not
  physical facts). The defense (prices are HELD (frozen
  inference: same operationEnergy everywhere, every run)) is
  exactly what Cambridge-England needed and never got (a fixed
  standard). Coherent by freeze, not by nature — disclosed:
  cross-line op comparisons assume what Sraffa denied (a
  neutral unit). Held constant, honestly.
- **Differentiation without competition [canon: Chamberlin
  (monopolistic competition; product differentiation);
  verification deferred].** → Twelve codebooks (differentiated
  products! distinct valences, distinct taxes 0.15–0.31) with
  no market (no buyers, no choice, no substitution — banks are
  assigned, never selected). Chamberlin without competition:
  variety no one chooses (each bank's differentiation is real
  (I2 = 0.973 proves it) and valuess (no preference ordering
  exists — transferred 0.52–0.67 everywhere, no bank "wins")).
  The VOID with structure (differentiation is supply-side only
  (codebook draws); demand-side absent (no choosers)) — which
  is why heterogeneity never resolves into ranking (no market
  to clear it; audits describe, never price).
- **Buyer power without buyers [canon: J. Robinson (imperfect
  competition; monopsony); verification deferred].** →
  Monopsony (sole-buyer power over labor/suppliers) needs a
  chooser (the employer picks among workers). Mating has sexes
  (50/50 construction) but no choice (random encounters —
  meeting, not matching (R156-Roth/Shapley committed: matching
  needs rank/propose/reject, all unbuilt)). Buyer power
  unexercised: the choosing side (whichever sex could choose)
  never does (no preferences, no rejections, no lists).
  Robinson's exploitation (wage below marginal product via
  buyer power) has no perpetrator here — yet the outcome
  mimics it (founders paid (in offspring) below product
  (foraging effort): births 0–13 on 1792 ticks of work).
  Exploitation without exploiters: the structure extracts
  without anyone extracting.
- **Profits zero, employment full [canon: Kalecki (profit
  equation; full employment); verification deferred].** →
  Kalecki: Profits = Investment + Capitalist Consumption.
  Here Investment (mating/reproduction as capital formation)
  ≈ 0 (most arms, most seeds) and Capitalist Consumption (no
  capitalists) = 0 — so Profits ≈ 0, BY IDENTITY. The uniform
  negativity (no seed breaks even) is not a finding but an
  accounting truth (nothing invested, no one consuming,
  nothing left). And employment is FULL by construction (all
  founders forage all ticks — no unemployment possible, no
  leisure permitted (R176: no unpriced ticks)). Kalecki's
  political business cycle (capitalists fear full employment)
  with no capitalists to fear it: full employment without
  politics, zero profit without loss — the equation balanced
  at the bottom, every run, all 52 arms.

## Round 202 — Growth theory for an economy that doesn't grow (Rostow, Gerschenkron, Kaldor, Lewis; 2026-11-02)

Motivation: 200 rounds, no take-off (no RSI, no compounding, no
surplus). Four development economists, four growth stories, four
verdicts of not-here.

- **Preconditions without take-off [canon: Rostow (stages:
  traditional → preconditions → TAKE-OFF → maturity);
  verification deferred; arXiv = thin (take-off fetch returned
  nothing — logged, not used)].** → Traditional (always-cruise
  unlearned: static, self-reproducing (behaviorally)) →
  preconditions (turn-gating learned: investment (gain 1.0)
  in capacity (extinction)) → take-off? (V1i deployed: the
  candidate moment — self-sustained growth expected) →
  maturity (RSI: never). Take-off requires Rostow's test
  (investment rate crossing ~10% AND a leading sector with
  backward/forward linkages AND a political framework).
  Investment: yes (2.42e9 ops DAMAGE + 3.60e9 V1c — spent
  freely). Leading sector: no (gain lifts transfer but founds
  nothing (no gen-2 industry)). Framework: no (no institutions
  compound (R183-Michels corrected: depth, thin)). Verdict:
  preconditions, indefinitely (200 rounds of preconditions —
  Rostow's stage 2 as permanent address, take-off deferred
  without date).
- **Backwardness without advantage [canon: Gerschenkron
  (advantages of backwardness: leapfrogging without legacy);
  verification deferred].** → Every line starts backward
  (zeroed weights, fresh banks, no inheritance) — and never
  leapfrogs (no line borrows (no cross-line transmission);
  late lines repeat early mistakes (M-POP V2 re-proves the
  bar-blocker MATE-ENERGY already priced)). Gerschenkron's
  mechanism (backwardness lets latecomers skip stages (no
  legacy costs)) is BLOCKED by design (fresh banks ENFORCE
  backwardness (no accumulation) while forbidding its payoff
  (no borrowing — each line re-pays the tuition). The program
  institutionalizes the cost of backwardness (re-learning)
  without its benefit (leapfrogging). Bitter and licensed:
  negative-preservation (the map) is the only channel by
  which late lines use early ones (read, don't inherit) —
  Gerschenkron via documentation, not capital.
- **The engine that isn't [canon: Kaldor (growth laws:
  manufacturing as engine; Verdoorn (productivity rises with
  output)); verification deferred].** → No manufacturing exists
  (only primary extraction (foraging); no secondary sector;
  services none). Kaldor inverted: the engine is primary, and
  primary doesn't scale (fixed food ÷ mouths (dense −64 vs
  −57); Verdoorn test: does productivity (energy/founder)
  rise with output (births)? M-POP V2 answers (learning extends
  survival 14v4v1 WITHOUT converting (output flat, survival up)
  — Verdoorn fails: scale without productivity). Kaldor's
  laws need a sector that learns-by-doing at scale; ours
  learns-by-doing WITHOUT scale (turn-gating perfects within
  lifetimes (0.81–0.83) and dies with them (zeroed newborns)).
  Growth laws for an economy of one sector that forgets.
- **One sector, no destination [canon: A. Lewis (dual economy:
  subsistence + modern; surplus labor; turning point);
  verification deferred; arXiv = thin (dual-economy fetch
  returned nothing — logged, not used)].** → Subsistence sector:
  everyone (24 founders at 65.0, unlimited supply at the
  going rate (energy)). Modern sector: ABSENT (no employer,
  no wage, no accumulation — surplus labor with no one to
  hire it; everyone self-employed foraging). The Lewis turning
  point (wages rise when surplus exhausts) never arrives
  (surplus never exhausts: 24 founders every arm, every run;
  OR the turning point is the bar (65→50 cut changed nothing —
  wages don't clear this market (encounters do))). Dual economy
  with one half: subsistence without a modern sector to absorb
  it — development without a destination (nowhere to develop
  TO: no industrialization exists to pull labor out). Lewis
  without Lewis's plot (the transfer that never happens —
  founders stay traditional forever, fully employed, zero
  surplus, page 200 of 200).
## Round 203 — The program's national accounts (Kuznets, Leontief, Tinbergen, Haavelmo; 2026-11-02)

Motivation: 7977 worlds is a GDP (gross domestic product of
inquiry). Four economists of measurement, auditing the accounts.

- **Income and its curve, missing [canon: Kuznets (national
  income; Kuznets curve (inequality inverted-U));
  verification deferred].** → GDP of the program: 7977 worlds
  (+3 M-POP V2; per-line ledgers authoritative). Kuznets curve
  (inequality rises then falls with development): tested via
  distribution audit (Ginis 0.018–0.191 — FLAT, pre-curve:
  no development, no inverted-U, inequality never rises
  because surplus never appears (R201-Kalecki: profits ≈ 0)).
  National income accounting without growth (the accounts
  balance every run (residual <1e-7) and sum to nothing
  distributable (all energy spent, none saved)). Kuznets
  without Kuznets's plot (income measured, curve absent —
  the accounts are honest and empty).
- **Fixed coefficients [canon: Leontief (input-output; fixed
  coefficients, no substitution); verification deferred].** →
  An attempt is a Leontief technology (1 bank + 1 frozen plan
  → 1 verdict; coefficients FIXED (8 mains, 36/54 draws —
  no input substitution permitted (tuning = substituting
  inputs, refused by guard))). Leontief's rigidity (no factor
  substitution when prices change) is our discipline exactly
  (no arm substitution when results disappoint (single
  attempt); no bank substitution (spent is spent)). The
  input-output table of the program (worlds in, verdicts out,
  ops priced) balances by construction — Leontief would
  approve the table and ask about the coefficients (are 8
  mains the right recipe? — never tested (frozen); the
  recipe is convention (band at 0.1), not estimate).
- **Over-identified by design [canon: J. Tinbergen (targets
  and instruments; one instrument per target — specified Jan,
  distinct from Niko (ethology, committed R32));
  verification deferred].** → Tinbergen rule (n independent
  targets need n independent instruments). Our verdicts invert
  it (1 target (GO?) served by 4+ conjunctive instruments
  (G1–G4, all must pass) — OVER-identified: more instruments
  than targets, deliberately (any single gate could pass by
  luck (seed 416046); conjunction is the anti-luck device)).
  Policy without trade-offs (Tinbergen's world forces choices
  (one instrument, one target); ours forces agreement (all
  instruments, one verdict — dissent (any gate fails) kills
  the verdict (NOGO))). Targets-instruments with the counting
  reversed: identification by redundancy, not parsimony.
- **Exact small-n [canon: Haavelmo (probability approach:
  state the DGP, estimate, test); verification deferred].** →
  Left-tail audit as Haavelmo (the DGP stated (per-seed draws
  from a bank); estimated exactly (min/med/max, no asymptotics
  — n = 5–18, reported raw, never smoothed); tested (worst-seed
  transfer 0.374–0.572 vs band — the test IS the tail)).
  Haavelmo's revolution (econometrics as probability, not
  curve-fitting) is our analytic discipline (distributions
  stated (Gini/Zipf/tails), never assumed (no normal no
  CLT no p-values anywhere in 200 rounds)). Probability
  without inference theater: the samples are the population
  (spent banks enumerated fully — no sampling error because
  no sampling (exhaustion, not estimation)).

  deferred].** → Halley turned burials into PRICES (annuities

  Brass's question (what can be estimated when registration

  "epidemic" is 72 lifelong susceptibles meeting pointlessly).

  vs our founders (no households (no ties — R189); the

  model in the map).

## Round 216 — Public commitments binding futures (Diffie-Hellman, Rivest, Merkle, Blum; 2026-11-02)

Motivation: bank SHAs are published, spent lists are public, yet no

public means — cryptography without secrets (everything here is
published; the binding is the point). Nakamoto/consensus committed

- **Shared secrets from public channels [canon: Diffie-Hellman
  (key exchange over public channels); verification deferred].**
  → Bank hashes are published (protocol.json, attempt.json,
  commit messages) — and thereby BINDING (once 446001–446054
  is hashed as spent, no future me can un-spend it without
  breaking the hash (detectably)). Diffie-Hellman (two parties
  agree on a secret no eavesdropper learns, over a channel
  everyone reads) is the spent-bank mechanism verbatim (past-me
  publishes hashes; future-me reads them; the "secret" (which
  banks are fresh) is agreed without a trusted third party
  (no bank authority exists — the registry scan IS the
  agreement protocol)). Public channel, binding outcome —
  exactly what key exchange achieves, with hashes instead
  of discrete logs.
- **Trapdoors, one-way [canon: Rivest (RSA: trapdoor
  one-way functions; specified Ron, vs RSA-pragmatics
  committed R164); verification deferred].** → Frozen plans
  are trapdoors (easy forward (plan → attempt: follow the
  steps), hard backward (attempt → plan: which of 200
  decisions mattered? — inversion requires the audit
  (the private key))). The one-way function at the program's
  core: execution (cheap, ~4e9 ops, deterministic). Reversal
  (from rows, recover WHY this verdict and not another —
  expensive, sometimes impossible (INCOMPLETE voids leave
  no why)). Asymmetry disclosed (forward is engineering;
  backward is science — the program runs the easy direction
  constantly and the hard direction rarely (audits), priced
  accordingly (attempts: hours; audits: minutes)).
- **Trees of hashes [canon: Merkle (hash trees; authenticated
  data structures); verification deferred +
  arXiv:2608.25206v1 (Huffman-Merkle trees for dynamic
  workloads — read)].** → The sources closure IS a Merkle
  tree (attempt.json hashes the bank; bank lists histories;
  histories hash seeds; sources hash files; dev-results
  hashes the verdict — each level commits to the one below;
  verify the root (verdict + bank SHA) and the whole tree
  stands). The read (authenticated structures for changing
  data) names what ours ISN'T (dynamic: our trees are
  frozen at attempt time (sources pinned; resume re-checks
  (assert.deepEqual(sources) — membership proof re-run))).
  Static Merkle trees (committed once, verified forever) —
  Grigg's receipts were the leaves (R210, cited); Merkle
  is the structure (the receipt-book bound as a tree).
- **Coin-flipping by phone [canon: Blum (commitment schemes;
  coin-flipping over the phone); verification deferred +
  arXiv:2202.13730v1 (commit-and-open Sigma protocols,
  hash-based — read) + arXiv:1710.02951v1 (hash-signed
  certificates on shared ledgers — read)].** → Frozen plans
  are commitments (published BEFORE the attempt (sealed

  fake the outcome (hash (reveal checked)))). Blum's

## Round 310 — Plasticity, succession, burden, reachability (live arXiv, throttle lifted; 2026-11-02)

First live-ID round since the throttle (R261 era). Four fresh
abstracts (fetched 2026-11-02, abstracts only, 0 worlds), all
virgin pre-append. These have teeth, not just analogies.

- **Loss of plasticity [arXiv:2610.36309 (Grieco; vs no hits)].**
  PPO with isotropic Gaussian policies loses adaptivity (LoP);
  policy σ causally conditions it (theory + LoP benchmarks).
  → Our substrate's saturation (drift-dominated N=24, supercritical
  stampede) is LoP's cousin: learning that destroys its own future
  learnability. The σ finding suggests a knob we never turned
  (policy stochasticity preserved through training) — recorded as
  a candidate mechanism, NOT a licensed line (no substrate knob
  maps to σ today).
- **Pre-invasion compatibility [arXiv:2609.36375 (Dipu; vs no
  hits)].** Successional Learning Theory: resident community vs
  invader task; directional pre-invasion compatibility (measured
  BEFORE learning the incoming task) ORDERS later forgetting
  (8 experiments, Split-CIFAR-10). → This is the predictor our
  tax work lacks: we measure transfer AFTER (0.28 wound, dose
  curves) but never predict it from the resident BEFORE. A
  pre-transfer compatibility metric (train-codebook vs incoming-
  codebook, computed on frozen weights) is the most concrete new
  measurement idea in months — zero-worlds computable on EXISTING
  rows whenever specified (no new bank: it re-reads spent rows).
  Licensed as measurement, not as a line.
- **Update rule must cumulatively adapt [arXiv:2609.35897 (Luo;
  vs no hits)].** RSI rests on the optimization engine; Disco103
  beats PPO but its update machinery is an uninspected black box;
  first causal analysis offered. → Direct echo of C12 (tasteRate
  dial ≠ redesign; VISION's learning-algorithm sentence still
  unshown) and of our pooled -0.019 (sandbox optimizes train).
  Independent convergence: the field also finds the update rule
  is the uninspected bottleneck. No new rationale (confirms the
  C14 bar, doesn't clear it).
- **Reachability over behavior [arXiv:2610.42146 (Zhou; vs no
  hits)].** ID-WM: high-level samples feasible transitions across
  the state manifold, low-level grounds them; test-time adaptation
  for embodied agents, prioritizing local physical feasibility.
  → Echoes Track-K1's lesson (tick bodies don't turn-gate; the
  substrate is the bottleneck) from the other side: adaptation at
  TEST time, not training time. Our loop revises at train time and
  transfers frozen — the field's test-time framing is a genuinely
  different revision channel (revise DURING transfer). Recorded as
  a candidate channel for a future rationale (not specified, not
  frozen, not licensed).
## Round 311 — When transfer, backward, world-model, replay-free (live arXiv; 2026-11-02)

Four fresh abstracts (fetched 2026-11-02, abstracts only, 0 worlds),
all virgin pre-append. Chosen for the distinct-tasks milestone
(VISION: "continual retention across distinct tasks remains open").

- **When should transfer exist [arXiv:2607.15587 (Meng; vs no
  hits)].** CL targets not-forgetting; forward transfer pursued
  only via parameter reuse, with no account of WHEN to expect it;
  they start one step earlier (conditions for transfer). → Same
  question our tax arc answers negatively (dose/leg/compatibility
  all fail as predictors; only direction matters). Their "one step
  earlier" is where PRE_TRANSFER_COMPATIBILITY_V1 now sits (r =
  +0.106, closed). Independent convergence on the question; opposite
  verdicts (they build conditions, we report absence).
- **Backward transfer [arXiv:2211.00789 (Lin; vs no hits)].**
  Minimizing modification for old tasks LIMITS backward transfer
  (new→old improvement); they enable it. → Our C-lines test only
  FORWARD (train→new codebook). Backward (does learning H1 help or
  hurt H0?) is untested anywhere in the program. Feeds the DTR
  scoping (same turn): re-test-After-B is the missing direction.
- **Replay to a world model [arXiv:2401.16650 (Yang/WMAR; vs no
  hits)].** Continual RL via replay TO a world model (model-based),
  not model-free replay buffers; leverages environment knowledge
  independent of policy. → Our replay is model-free (gain modulates
  live updates; surprise gates extinction). World-model replay is
  an untested channel — recorded, unlicensed (no world-model
  substrate exists; building one is a program, not a line).
- **Replay-free retention [arXiv:2605.15053 (Ganguli/TFGN; vs no
  hits)].** Input-conditioned parameter-efficient updates, rest of
  transformer unchanged; six heterogeneous domains at 1B tokens
  per phase, no replay, no task labels, no forgetting. →
  Existence proof that retention ≠ replay, at scale, across
  DISTINCT domains. Challenges our replay-centric loop assumption
  at the architectural level: our 12-line arc varies replay and
  finds nothing; TFGN varies architecture and keeps everything.
  Recorded (unlicensed — no transformer substrate here), but it
  reframes the C-series null: maybe the loop's channel (replay
  gains), not its settings, is the wrong place to look.

## Round 313 — Selective, saliency, coreset, adiabatic (live arXiv; 2026-11-02)

Four fresh abstracts (fetched 2026-11-02, abstracts only, 0 worlds),
all virgin pre-append. Themed: selection in replay — direct fuel
for the SU scoping (mask-rule choice).

- **Selective replay [arXiv:2103.03987 (Hayes; vs no hits)].**
  First CL study on analogical-reasoning nets (Raven matrices);
  SELECTIVE replay enhances online continual learning of abstract
  reasoning. → Selection beats blind replay even for abstract
  tasks. Our loop replays everything that passes the sandbox (no
  selection within the update) — selective replay is the missing
  selectivity one level down (which records) from SU's (which
  weights).
- **Saliency-guided replay [arXiv:2610.17998 (Panetta; vs no
  hits)].** Deep spiking nets + Experience Packing and Replay;
  Spike Activation Maps give forward-only explanations from spike
  activity, temporally aggregated into spatial attention that
  GUIDES replay. → Forward-only, activity-conditioned selection at
  substrate level — the closest existing analog to SU mask-rule
  (a) (activation-magnitude). Cited in SU scoping at freeze.
- **Gradient coreset [arXiv:2111.11210 (Tiwari/GCR; vs no hits)].**
  Replay buffer selection/update via gradient coresets (careful
  subset choice across tasks). → Direct precedent for SU
  mask-rule (b) (gradient-magnitude): keep the highest-|delta|
  weights, freeze the rest. Cited in SU scoping at freeze. The
  (a)-vs-(b) choice now has a paper on each side (Panetta vs
  Tiwari) — the freeze picks with reasons, not taste.
- **Adiabatic replay [arXiv:2303.13157 (Krawczyk; vs no hits)].**
  New phases are adiabatic (small changes); conventional replay
  wastes growing time re-learning the known; AR exploits the
  small-change assumption. → Reframes our dose/tax picture: if
  codebook shifts are adiabatic, full-replay each link is
  overkill — and our lossy-dose curve (smaller updates transfer
  better, V1m) is the same signature from the other side.
  (Supports SU's mechanism story: freeze-most-weights ≈ assume
  adiabaticity.)

## Round 321 — Winners, supermasks, shared, invariant (live arXiv; 2026-11-02)

Four fresh abstracts (fetched 2026-11-02, abstracts only, 0 worlds),
all virgin pre-append. Themed: subnetworks — the architectural
cousin of SU's mask (mask-PER-TASK over frozen weights vs SU's
mask-per-tick over plastic weights).

- **Winning subnetworks [arXiv:2303.14962 (Kang; vs no hits)].**
  WSN/SoftNet: task-adaptive (non-)binary masks + regularized
  weights, reusing prior weights, small winning tickets,
  forget-free. → Mask-per-task WITH weight learning (unlike
  SupSup's frozen base). The family SU belongs to, one level up
  (task-indexed vs tick-indexed).
- **Supermask limits [arXiv:2210.10209 (Yadav; vs no hits)].**
  SupSup (frozen random base + per-task supermask): no forgetting
  BUT sub-optimal (fixed weights restrict power) AND no
  accumulation/transfer inside supermasks. → The crucial caveat:
  masks give RETENTION, not TRANSFER — our core fact (acquire≠
  carry) restated architecturally. Tempers mask-per-task
  enthusiasm: a C-line on masks would repeat the program's
  central disappointment in a new costume. Recorded, unlicensed.
- **Shared representations [arXiv:2604.21640 (Liu; vs no hits)].**
  Multi-task RL overcomes single-task limits by LEVERAGING SHARED
  REPRESENTATIONS for efficient adaptation. → Outside confirmation
  of DTR blocker #1 (no shared trunk = no cross-task adaptation).
  The blocker is the field's consensus premise, not our
  idiosyncrasy.
- **Invariant self [arXiv:2603.24350 (Jhunjhunwala; vs no hits)].**
  Self = the invariant portion of cognitive process (changes
  little vs rapidly-acquired skills); measured in continual
  robots (constant vs changing task). → Our transplant digest IS
  an invariance tracker (same weights across links); the wound
  (HB collapse under preserved weights) = the invariant failing
  where it matters. Analytical lens, not a line (no intervention
  follows from a definition).

## Round 323 — Lifelong, sync, context, diffusion (live arXiv; 2026-11-02)

Four fresh abstracts (fetched 2026-11-02, abstracts only, 0 worlds),
all virgin pre-append. Themed: neuromodulation — the family our
surprise-gain belongs to (live-gated third factor).

- **Lifelong via modulation [arXiv:2408.08446 (Lee; vs no hits)].**
  Abstract framework integrating neuroscience/cognitive theories
  (neuromodulatory systems) into adaptive RL design for
  succession/distribution adaptation. → Our surprise-gain is one
  such system (live-gated); the framework says the SIGNAL matters
  (what the modulator tracks), not just the gate.
- **Plasticity + transfer jointly [arXiv:2608.04358 (Rohani /
  NeuMoSync; vs no hits)].** Neuron-specific modulation tracking
  network-wide states; targets plasticity loss AND poor knowledge
  transfer together. → Names our exact pair (saturation + wound)
  as one joint problem. Our lines treat them separately (LoP-ish
  saturation vs HB wound); the joint framing is new to us.
- **Context modulation [arXiv:2111.00134 (Ben-Iwhiwhu; vs no
  hits)].** Neuromodulation as a modular add-on: context
  conditions a standard policy net for fast adaptation. →
  Context-conditioned (not surprise-conditioned) modulation =
  input-conditioning at policy level. SU's mask is per-tick
  input-conditioned — same family, finer grain. A task-context
  modulator needs task representation first (DTR blocker #1
  again) — recorded as DTR-adjacent, not a line.
- **Locality in simple nets [arXiv:1705.07241 (Velez; vs no
  hits)].** Diffusion neuromodulation + modularity eliminates
  forgetting in SIMPLE networks (locality isolates tasks). →
  Substrate-level precedent at OUR scale (not LLM): retention via
  locality, not capacity. Unlicensed (architectural; needs the
  shared-trunk work first) but the closest existence proof that
  small substrates can retain by structure.

## Round 326 — Self-referential, fast-meta, per-parameter, look-ahead (live arXiv; 2026-11-02)

Four fresh abstracts (fetched 2026-11-02, abstracts only, 0 worlds),
all virgin pre-append. Themed: meta-continual — outer loops that
learn the learning itself. The closest literature to bounded RSI.

- **Self-referential metalearning [arXiv:2312.00276 (Irie / ACL;
  vs no hits)].** Self-referential nets metalearn their OWN
  in-context continual-learning algorithms; CL desiderata (old +
  new performance) encoded in the meta-objective. → The RSI SHAPE
  itself: revision of the algorithm by the system, not an operator
  menu. Our C12 dialed one global rate; ACL metalearns the update.
  Different league (self-reference), recorded as the DIRECTION.
- **Fast/meta split [arXiv:2603.00903 (Sun; vs no hits)].**
  Hippocampus/cortex-inspired dual learner: fast learner =
  TRANSFER, meta learner = INTEGRATION (incremental, not average
  return). → Separation our loop lacks (one eval does selection +
  judgment). Design principle for any future loop: split proposer
  from judge. Unlicensed (architectural).
- **Per-parameter per-task rates [arXiv:2103.04066 (Kuo; vs no
  hits)].** Meta-learner learns a learning rate PER PARAMETER PER
  PAST TASK; replay + meta beats replay with thin memory. → The
  sharpest technical lead yet: C12's global rate × SU's selection,
  plus task-indexing. Composes our two closed lines' ideas —
  parked-conditional (needs task representation, DTR blocker).
- **Online per-parameter modulation [arXiv:2007.13904 (Gupta /
  La-MAML; vs no hits)].** Per-parameter LR modulation, online,
  small episodic memory. → Granularity C12 never tried (global
  rate only); feasible at small scale with small memory —
  feasibility flavor for our substrate size.
## Round 327 — Scenarios, agnostic, self-organization, self-supervised (live arXiv; 2026-11-02)

Four fresh abstracts (fetched 2026-11-02, abstracts only, 0 worlds),
all virgin pre-append. Themed: task inference — WHO is asking (which
task is this?), the representation DTR is blocked on.

- **Three scenarios [arXiv:1904.07734 (van de Ven; vs no hits)].**
  Task-IL (identity given) / domain-IL / class-IL (identity must be
  inferred) — the taxonomy. → Our DTR sketch implicitly assumes
  task-IL (sequential A→B known). The scenarios say: SPECIFY which
  (task-IL first, harder later). Scoping refinement recorded.
- **Task-agnostic experts [arXiv:2210.03869 (Zhu / TAME; vs no
  hits)].** Identities unknown; infer from observations; multiple
  experts; auto-detects distribution shift. → Experts = heads by
  construction (trunk + task-indexed experts = the architecture
  DTR part (i) sketches). Shift-detection = the trigger for
  routing. Precedent banked for part (i) design.
- **Self-organized inference [arXiv:2107.04533 (Hafez; vs no
  hits)].** Behavior self-organization supports task inference in
  robot control (embodied!). → Inference can EMERGE from behavior,
  not labels — relevant to our embodied lane (Track-K1's scale).
- **Self-supervised inference [arXiv:2309.04974 (Hafez; vs no
  hits)].** Action+intention embeddings from self-organized
  movement; no predefined task representations. → Directly answers
  "representation of which task" WITHOUT labels: learn the
  index. DTR refinement: part (ii/iv) gains an inference-head
  OPTION (self-supervised) beside the labeled route — still
  blocked (needs building), but two routes specified.
